user_decision.label: Fixed Pool-local status band
user_decision.reason: Direct status avoids a panel, event list, Escape handling, and Mark-reviewed state, reducing accessibility verification and Task 144 implementation scope.

surface.placement: fixed Pool-local band directly below the complete expanded search/sort row and outside the internally scrolling Scratch list
surface.line_limit: at most one search-context line and one aggregate Pool-activity line
prohibited: Scratch-list proxy, placeholder, or pinned status row

count_and_indicator.total: header and collapsed count always mean all active Scratches
count_and_indicator.filtered: during a non-empty query only, render {visible} of {total} Scratches in the status band
count_and_indicator.collapsed: search does not filter switchers or total; use a non-control +{count} unseen-arrival marker plus a separate non-color lifecycle marker named Pool updated elsewhere.
count_and_indicator.remote_count: mounted-page count of active Scratches arriving remotely after the initial snapshot or last Review new; local creation and the initial snapshot do not count

hidden_selection.copy: Selected Scratch is hidden by this search.
hidden_selection.effect: clear only the Pool query; retain selected Scratch and Context
hidden_selection.focus: keep focus in the expanded Pool search field
hidden_selection.lifetime: persist exactly while the current non-empty query and authoritative data hide the selected row; clear without focus movement when resolved

remote_arrival.effect: revalidate unseen active arrivals under current sort, clear the arrival count, scroll and focus the first surviving unseen row without selecting it
remote_arrival.empty_revalidation: clear the count and focus the expanded Pool search field when no unseen arrival survives

lifecycle.effect: clear only accumulated non-selected lifecycle categories and focus the expanded Pool search field
lifecycle.selected_external_removal: exclude from the ordinary activity line; update row/total from authority and immediately delegate copy, controls, dismissal, focus, and restore cancellation to DP-VQ01

mixed_activity.clause_forms: 1 new or {count} new; 1 archived or {count} archived; 1 deleted or {count} deleted; 1 restored or {count} restored
mixed_activity.actions: Review new only when arrivals exist; Dismiss only when lifecycle aggregates exist

dismissal_and_lifetime.arrival_clear: Review new, Inbox route exit, or reload only
dismissal_and_lifetime.lifecycle_clear: Dismiss, Inbox route exit, or reload only
dismissal_and_lifetime.storage: mounted Inbox-page presentation only; never durable domain truth or device preference

focus_and_accessibility.arrival: remote arrival and non-selected lifecycle changes never steal focus or selection
focus_and_accessibility.announcement: announce each newly changed visible activity sentence once through one polite atomic status; never announce rerender, sort, collapse/expand, theme change, or elapsed time
focus_and_accessibility.compact: literal +{count} and a separate lifecycle marker provide non-color cues and accessible names but are not controls
focus_and_accessibility.selected_disappearance: DP-VQ01 exclusively owns the blocking transition and its focus contract

motion.ordinary: all entry, replacement, clear, band-size, marker, scroll, and focus changes are immediate
motion.prohibited: fade, slide, scale, spinner, pulse, ping, bounce, blink, flicker, and layout-transition animation
motion.reduced_motion: identical geometry, copy, controls, timing, focus, and lifetime

theme_mapping.griddo: restrained semantic band and marker using canonical border, muted, primary, text, action, and focus roles
theme_mapping.tiny-desk: ruled-paper strip below wood tools, stationery text and actions, and pin/bar-like compact marker
theme_mapping.neumorphism: shallow inset status well, named raised action, and raised compact marker within the existing shadow family
theme_mapping.claymorphism: shape-preserving soft inset ribbon, restrained raised text action, and puffy non-color compact marker
theme_mapping.origami: attached folded-paper strip, seam-separated lines and actions, and folded-tab compact marker
theme_mapping.terminal: variable-driven static bordered line, bracketed text action, and text/shape marker with no fixed JSX color or blink
theme_mapping.retro-mac: in-place 1-bit pane below FIND/tools, hard text control, and hard-outline marker with no new window
theme_mapping.graphite: editorial caption band, strengthened rules, restrained monochrome text action, and index-like compact marker

implementation_boundary.excludes: selection/query semantics, persistence, repository truth, DP-VQ01 changes, product implementation in Task 111, and every Staging/Explorer state or realization

exact_release.consumption_condition: Task 111 user checkpoint accepted; its plan marker remains open until then
